column3: “make a long blast” renders “blow”; “fall down flat” renders “fall in its place,” and “straight ahead” renders “before himself.”
“let seven priests carry” renders “seven priests shall carry.”
“armed men” renders the Hebrew singular “the armed one.”
“while they continued to blow” renders “walking and blowing.”
“he had the ark … taken around” renders “he caused the ark to go around.”
“in the same manner” renders “according to this custom.”
“under the ban” renders “a devoted thing”; “harlot” renders “prostitute.”
“covet them” reflects a variant reading; the Hebrew reads “devote to destruction.” “accursed” renders “a devoted thing.”
NASB omits “the” before “priests”; “fell down flat” renders “fell in its place.”
“utterly destroyed” renders the verb for devoting to destruction; “the edge of the sword” renders “the mouth of the sword.”
“all she has” renders “all who belong to her.”
“who were spies” renders “who had spied out”; “relatives” renders “families.”
“made them take an oath” renders “administered an oath”; NASB adds “the loss of.”
